mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate below 0.25% compresses the risk-free rate, reducing equity discount rates and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days through lower cost of capital for corporate valuation.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.25%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained unemployment rate exceeding 5.0% for three consecutive months signals deteriorating labor market conditions, reducing consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE exceeds 5.0% for 3 consecutive months, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in residential construction (HOUST) and consumer spending (RSAFS) signal a broad-based demand contraction, triggering reduced corporate revenue expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS decline by more than 1.0% month-over-month, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: During high inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 3.0% year-over-year), a federal funds rate above 4.0% triggers monetary tightening that increases equity discount rates and reduces valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 3.0% and FEDFUNDS > 4.0%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production below 95.0 (index 2017=100) indicates weakening manufacturing activity, reducing corporate profits and driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO is below 95.0, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A residential construction permit level above 600.0 thousand units signals strong housing market activity, boosting consumer confidence and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when HOUST exceeds 600.0, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A two-month consecutive decline in industrial production below 90.0 (index 2017=100) signals severe manufacturing slowdown, triggering equity sell-offs due to reduced corporate profitability and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO is below 90.0 for two consecutive months, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A persistently high unemployment rate above 5.0% compresses wage growth and consumer spending, reducing corporate revenue streams and driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE is above 5.0%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.02.
